library.subtitle: All games installed on this PC, in one place.
library.emptyBody: Add your first game to get started. Pick any .exe on this PC and Sosis Launcher will track it.
library.defaultSortDesc: How games are ordered when the library opens.
library.defaultViewDesc: Grid of cards or compact list.
library.confirmRemoveDesc: Ask for confirmation when removing a game from the library.
library.trackModeDesc: Smart watches the game process tree on Windows; basic uses the launched process only.
favorites.subtitle: Games you starred, ready to jump back in.
favorites.emptyBody: Tap the star on any game card and it will show up here.
search.emptyBody: Nothing in your library matches this search. Try a different name.
details.removeNote: Removing only clears the library entry. Your game files are never deleted.
details.noDescription: No description yet. Use Edit Game to add one.
details.shortcutCreated: Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts created
details.shortcutUnsupported: Shortcuts are only supported on Windows.
details.removeConfirmDetail: This only removes the entry from Sosis Launcher. No game files will be deleted.
art.title: Choose artwork · {name}
art.subtitle: Pick a candidate below, then choose whether it becomes the cover or the banner. Nothing downloads until you pick.
art.customHint: Paste image URLs, one per line…
art.noResults: No candidates found. Try another provider or paste URLs.
art.resultsHint: Click an image, then choose cover or banner.
art.copyrightNote: Only artwork you have the right to use should be applied. Candidates come from public metadata APIs or your own URLs; the selected image is cached locally for your personal library.
general.runAtLoginDesc: Start Sosis Launcher automatically when Windows starts.
general.closeToTrayDesc: Keep running in the system tray when the window is closed.
general.startMinimizedDesc: Open to the tray instead of the full window.
general.checkUpdatesDesc: Silently look for launcher updates in the background.
appearance.themeDesc: Dark is the recommended premium gaming look.
appearance.accentDesc: Used for buttons, highlights and glows.
appearance.uiScaleDesc: Scale the whole interface from 80% to 130%.
appearance.backgroundGlowDesc: Subtle ambient gradients behind the UI.
language.chooseDesc: Applies immediately and is remembered after restart.
language.rtlNote: Persian uses a fully right-to-left layout: sidebar on the right, mirrored navigation and alignment. English uses left-to-right.
ai.providerDesc: Any OpenAI-compatible API (custom base URL supported).
ai.baseUrlDesc: Example: https://api.openai.com/v1 or your own server.
ai.modelDesc: Model name served by the endpoint, e.g. gpt-4o-mini.
ai.apiKeyDesc: Stored encrypted on this device (Windows DPAPI). Never sent anywhere except your API endpoint.
ai.keyStored: A key is stored ·••••••••  (type to replace)
ai.includeLibraryDesc: Let the assistant see your games to answer questions like “which game should I play?”.
ai.securityNote: The key is encrypted with Windows safeStorage before being written to disk. It never appears in the UI, logs or repository.
ai.subtitle: Ask anything — the assistant knows your library when context is enabled.
ai.emptyBody: Add an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and API key to start chatting.
ai.greeting: Hi! I'm the Sosis Launcher assistant. Ask me about your games, play time, or anything else.
ai.suggest3: What is my most played game?
ai.notConfigured: Configure the AI assistant first (Settings → AI Assistant).
ai.errors.badKey: The API rejected the key (401/403). Check the key.
ai.errors.notFound: Endpoint or model not found (404). Check the base URL and model.
ai.errors.rateLimit: Rate limited by the provider (429). Try again shortly.
ai.errors.dns: Could not resolve the host. Check the base URL / network.
ai.errors.refused: Connection refused. Is the server running?
ai.errors.network: Network error while contacting the API.
downloads.subtitle: Download settings and active transfers.
downloads.concurrentDesc: Maximum parallel transfers for future download features.
downloads.autoUpdateDesc: Download launcher updates automatically when found.
downloads.futureNote: Game installs and asset packs will appear here in future versions; the queue engine is already in place.
downloads.emptyBody: Updates and future downloads will show their progress here.
notifications.sessionEndDesc: Notify with the session length when a game closes.
notifications.updatesDesc: Notify when a new launcher version is published.
notifications.unsupported: Notifications are unavailable on this system.
storage.recoveredNote: A corrupted database was detected and safely recovered on last start. A backup was kept next to the data file.
overlay.enableDesc: Show a small transparent panel while games run.
overlay.positionDesc: Corner of the screen for the overlay.
overlay.scaleDesc: Overall size of the overlay panel.
overlay.marginDesc: Distance from the screen edge in pixels.
overlay.showFpsDesc: Display the frame-rate readout next to play time.
overlay.previewHint: Shows the overlay for a few seconds with a demo session.
overlay.safetyNote: The overlay is a separate click-through window. Nothing is injected into game processes; FPS is measured safely from the compositor and shows “--” when unavailable.
advanced.hwAccelDesc: Disable only if you see rendering glitches (applies after relaunch).
advanced.devToolsDesc: Open DevTools with the window (for development).
advanced.relaunchHint: Relaunch the launcher to apply this change.
advanced.resetConfirmDetail: Games and play time are kept. Only preferences are reset.
advanced.safetyNote: Sosis Launcher never deletes game files, touches the registry, kills unrelated processes or collects personal data.
about.blurb: A modern, bilingual Windows game launcher: library management, safe play-time tracking, an independent in-game overlay and an AI assistant. Built with Electron.
updates.upToDate: You are on the latest version ({version}).
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Check the logs for details.
errors.exeMissing: The game executable was not found. It may have been moved or deleted.
errors.gameNotFoundBody: This game is no longer in your library.
notify.gameStarted.title: Game started
notify.sessionFinished.title: Game session finished
notify.updateAvailable.title: Update available
notify.updateAvailable.body: Sosis Launcher v{version} is ready to download.
notify.test.title: Sosis Launcher
profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Your Sosis account, synced with the web platform.
profile.notLogged: Sign in to sync your play time
profile.syncNote: Sessions are uploaded automatically when a game closes. Your rank appears on the leaderboard.
profile.err.weak-password: Password must be at least 6 characters.
profile.err.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
board.title: Leaderboard
board.subtitle: Community play-time ranking and most popular games.
board.empty: No data yet — be the first!
board.offline: Server unreachable — showing nothing until reconnected.
general.autoUpdateDesc: When a newer version is published, download the setup automatically, verify it, restart and apply.
